series.name: Gravel Earth Series
series.tagline: Klassmark's licensed global gravel series, 2023-2026. Replaced by The Traka World Series in 2027.
series.description: The Gravel Earth Series was Klassmark's global gravel series from 2023 through 2026, built around The Traka in Girona. Independent organizers joined under license and borrowed The Traka's name and methods in return. The calendar grew to more than 20 events in 13 countries in 2025, then shrank to twelve for 2026, the final season. From 2027 Klassmark runs The Traka World Series instead, a seven-round calendar under its own control.
series.history: Klassmark, the Girona company behind The Traka, launched Gravel Earth in 2023 as a license system: partner races on several continents carried the series name and drew on The Traka's image and practices, an arrangement that never ran free of friction. Partners included Oregon Trail Gravel Grinder, Lost and Found and CORE4 in the United States and Migration Gravel Race in Kenya. The calendar passed 20 events in 13 countries in 2025; for 2026 Klassmark cut it to twelve and never disclosed a prize purse. On November 5, 2026, Klassmark confirmed Gravel Earth would not continue and announced The Traka World Series for 2027.
series.format_overview: Gravel Earth mixed single-day races such as The Traka 200 and Gravel Desert with stage races such as Oregon Trail Gravel Grinder and Migration Gravel Race under one points-based championship. The event list below is the final 2026 calendar.
